messages:
Maya (ML Eng): quick preflight for catalog go-live tomorrow — need to confirm outstanding deps + ownerships. TL;DR: licenses for 3 new open models, perf profiles for 2, staging canary, and final PR reviews.
Ezra (Platform): thanks — I pushed a tiny schema change to model-metadata today, see PR #482. Can owners review? CC @Nina, @Samir.
Nina (Curation): on it. I'll check license rows first. Which models are we most worried about?
Maya (ML Eng): primarily: oryx-7b, marlin-lite, and verve-13b-quant. Oryx: permissive but need attribution note; Marlin: awaiting CLA confirmation; Verve: upstream license ambiguous for quantized artifacts.
LegalBot: Oryx-7b: license OK (Apache-2.0 + attribution required). Marlin-lite: CLA pending from upstream maintainer — ETA 24h. Verve-13b-quant: flagged — distributing quantized weights needs explicit consent; legal advise: block until explicit permission.
Samir (Infra): infra checklist: staging pool has GPUs reserved for canary (2xA100), caching proxy ready, model artifacts path /models/staging/ is populated for Oryx & Marlin. Verve quant artifacts missing.
Kai (SRE): canary run slot is at 10:00 UTC. I'll coordinate the traffic ramp for 15 minutes. If 95th p99 latency > 350ms, we rollback.
Maya (ML Eng): perf profiles: I have CSVs from local runs for Oryx & Marlin — submissions in drive: /perf/csvs/oryx-marlin-2026-03-16.csv. Oryx perf looks within SLA. Marlin shows tokenization variance; might need a tokenizer patch.
Nina (Curation): PR #482 reviewed. Found a missing field in the manifest: "license_url" is nullable but should be required for non-commercial flags. Small comment left.
Ezra (Platform): I'll apply the schema patch if @Nina approves. Also, for rollout policy we need to bind model -> fallback mapping for verve -> marlin-lite (if verve blocked). Who owns the fallback mapping?
Samir (Infra): I'll own the mapping in router config. Leave the canary flag to me.
Maya (ML Eng): action list: 1) Nina to confirm license rows (Nina) 2) Legal to confirm Marlin CLA (LegalBot) 3) Samir to set fallback routing + canary (Samir) 4) Ezra to merge schema patch + tag release (Ezra) 5) Kai to run canary at 10:00 UTC (Kai) 6) Maya to monitor quality regressions with eval set A.
Nina (Curation): license rows: Oryx -> attribution note added; Marlin -> maintainer pinged (sent @maintainers link); Verve -> awaiting maintainer reply (pinged).
LegalBot: Marlin-lite CLA: maintainer has agreed in thread, but we need signed CLA doc. @Nina please collect PDF; until then, mark Marlin as "restricted" in catalog.
Maya (ML Eng): can we set catalog flag "restricted" to prevent public-hosted usage but allow dedicated/private?
Ezra (Platform): yes — set model.visibility = "restricted" in catalog API; I can do that as a one-off.
Samir (Infra): deploy plan: if Verve missing, we deploy Oryx + Marlin (restricted) to staging. Verve gated. Router fallback: verve -> marlin-lite, marlin-lite -> oryx. I'll push config in ~30m.
Kai (SRE): quick note — increase token cache TTL for Marlin in staging to 2s to reduce cold-starts.
Maya (ML Eng): eval quick check: running eval A now against Oryx and Marlin (restricted). I'll post a short summary in 30m.
Samir (Infra): PRs to watch: #482 (schema), #489 (router mapping), #495 (model manifest uploads).
Nina (Curation): small metadata ask: include provenance.url in manifest for all open models. Helps audits.
Ezra (Platform): noted. I'll add a validation: manifest.provenance.url required for catalog-eligible models.
Maya (ML Eng): small snippet for manifest example (please include license field):
```json
{
  "name": "oryx-7b",
  "version": "2026-03-16",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "license_url": "https://github.com/oryx/license",
  "provenance": { "url": "https://huggingface.co/oryx/7b" }
}
```
Samir (Infra): FYI I'll tag the canary with label canary=catalog-launch. deploy-bot will post status.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: catalog-launch-canary-20260317 at 10:00 UTC — job id dj-7782.
Kai (SRE): I'll be on standby during canary. If we see token errors or regression > 2% in rouge, we stop.
Maya (ML Eng): thanks all. Current blocking items: Verve license (blocks Verve deployment), Marlin CLA PDF (blocks public), merge PR #482. Everything else green.
Nina (Curation): I'll escalate Verve maintainer ping via their GH issues and DM.
Ezra (Platform): merging #482 now (after Nina's thumbs).
Nina (Curation): :thumbsup: merged.
Samir (Infra): pushed router mapping. PR #489 ready for review.
Maya (ML Eng): final ask: whoever is running the canary — paste the quick perf summary in this thread after run so we have a record.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: dj-7782 — logs: https://deploys.internal/jobs/dj-7782/logs
Kai (SRE): canary done. Summary: Oryx p50 120ms, p95 310ms, p99 340ms; Marlin (restricted) p50 140ms, p95 360ms, p99 420ms (exceeded our p95 threshold), quality regression on eval A = 0.8% (within threshold). Rolling back Marlin to warm pool and reducing concurrency. Next steps: Samir to tune batching, Maya to run quick tokenizer patch bench.
Samir (Infra): tuned dynamic batching params, redeploying Marlin canary in 20m.
Maya (ML Eng): noted. I'll run tokenizer patch now and post results.
Nina (Curation): license update: Marlin CLA PDF uploaded to drive. LegalBot: can you confirm acceptance?
LegalBot: received PDF, signature verified. Marlin-lite: cleared for restricted distribution. Recommend documenting CLA in catalog entry.
Maya (ML Eng): great. Closing loop: Verve still blocked; catalog launch will proceed with Oryx public + Marlin restricted. Will announce go-live with those caveats. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
